_comment: Tunable strategy/risk knobs. NOT secret - committed to git on purpose so the monthly auto-retune workflow can propose changes here as a reviewable pull request diff. See README.md for what each field means. Re-tuned 2026-10-07 on the CORRECTED backtest (timestamp-aligned symbols + Alpaca fees; the 2026-09-14 tune ran on a backtest that misaligned SOL's data by over a year and charged no fees, so its numbers were invalid). 729-combination grid, 538 passed the safety filter (drawdown <=32%, win rate >=35% in every window). This combo: avg +20.3% over ~3mo/~1yr/~5yr (+8.6%/+10.8%/+41.4%, worst drawdown -15.3%) vs +10.7% (+9.3%/+1.5%/+21.4%, -19.4%) for the previous 4h/8% settings; beat them in 4 of 5 calendar years 2022-2026. Caveat: results are sensitive to short_sma_window (4h +10.7%, 6h +20.3%, 8h +12.2%), so treat the margin as optimistic. trailing_stop_pct tested and left off.
